newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FEMALE RUGBY FAN PUTS SHIRT ON ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FEMALE RUGBY FAN PUTS SHIRT ON ENGLAND.

text.p: A female punter has wagered 46,000 pounds ($74,600), thought to be the largest amount ever staked on a rugby match, on England defeating Ireland in their Five Nations encounter in Dublin on Saturday.
The same unnamed woman successfully staked 18,000 pounds ($29,200) on England beating Scotland a fortnight ago, winning 3,000 pounds ($4,860) at the odds of 6-1 ON.
She stands to collect over 15,000 pounds ($24,300) if her side win again on Saturday at odds of 3-1 ON.

"You're talking serious money," said William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe. "If I had that sort of cash riding on the outcome of a game I'd want to be in the dressing-room giving the pre-match team-talk with Jack Rowell."
